source: Hugging Face official repository API and immutable Git HEAD

models.purpose: MemoryOS official default SentenceTransformer embedding model
models.load_policy: Pass the immutable local snapshot path through Memoryos.embedding_model_name and require HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 and TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1.

models.purpose: MemGAS official default Contriever embedding model

license.policy: Project-local non-commercial research reproduction only; do not redistribute weights without a separate rights review.

models.security_note: The only available model weight is pytorch_model.bin. The official Hugging Face expanded tree reported safe scanning and four innocuous pickle imports; retain the exact file hash after download.
models.load_policy: The hashed MemGAS execution overlay substitutes only the hard-coded repository string with this immutable local path and requires HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 and TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1.

download_policy.scheduler_gate: Do not download either snapshot until the Wave-1 controller is terminal and its model services are stopped.
download_policy.transport: Download directly on the server into the exact project-owned path; if transferred from the Mac, use resumable sftp limited to 4096 Kbit/s.
download_policy.post_download: Verify resolved revision, selected file names, file count, byte count, and SHA-256 for every local file before lifecycle execution.
download_policy.offline_execution: Lifecycle and numerical runs must deny network model resolution and load only these local snapshots.
download_policy.cleanup: comparisons/model-retention-policy.v2.json governs cleanup; source checkouts, environments, datasets, evidence, archives, shared models, and failed partial targets are not cleanup candidates.
